classification.difficultyReason: Recall the taught diagonal properties of four named special quadrilaterals.

content.prompt: List all the properties of the diagonals of:

answer.worked: The diagonals bisect each other: their intersection is the midpoint of each diagonal.

answer.short: The diagonals bisect each other at right angles. Each diagonal bisects the two interior angles through which it passes.
answer.worked: A rhombus is a parallelogram, so its diagonals bisect each other. Its diagonals also meet at right angles, and each diagonal bisects the two interior angles through which it passes.

answer.short: The diagonals are equal in length and bisect each other.
answer.worked: A rectangle is a parallelogram, so its diagonals bisect each other. The diagonals of a rectangle are also equal in length.

answer.short: The diagonals are equal in length and bisect each other at right angles. Each diagonal bisects the interior angles through which it passes, meeting the adjacent sides at $45^{\circ}$.
answer.worked: A square is both a rectangle and a rhombus. Its rectangle properties give equal diagonals that bisect each other. Its rhombus properties give perpendicular diagonals that bisect the interior angles. Each interior angle is $90^{\circ}$, so each diagonal meets the adjacent sides at $90^{\circ}\div2=45^{\circ}$.
